jobs.occupation: Commodity Manager (m/w/d) Machined parts Generator (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as a Commodity Manager (f/m/d) and take the lead in strategic procurement for Machined Parts for Large Generators. You will develop and align a resilient Ecosystem strategy in collaboration with commodity circles, ensuring it aligns with Siemens Energy’s global strategy and business objectives for Large Gas Turbines and Steam Turbines. By implementing a global Ecosystem strategy, you will support our business targets of Growth, Resilience, and Cost Out. Your expertise in supply market knowledge will go beyond procurement perspectives, generating significant value and impact.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Provide vision, strategy, and functional leadership to a global commodity team, embodying ownership, innovation, and transformation aligned with Siemens Energy’s values.
* Lead and develop your team in commodity management, contract negotiations, supplier relationship management, and strategy implementation, while negotiating global frame contracts and price lists.
* Collaborate with Strategic Procurement leadership and key customers to enhance commodity structure and organization, sharing valuable supplier market intelligence across Siemens Energy.
* Develop and implement forward-looking commodity ecosystem strategies that align with business needs, leveraging enhanced Commodity Circle networks to drive value creation.
* Manage relationships with strategic suppliers to ensure alignment with company demands, facilitating early supplier involvement and driving cost-out initiatives.
* Identify procurement risks and opportunities through supplier market analysis and scouting, integrating findings into ecosystem strategies for continuous improvement of managed spend.

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree, or equivalent experience in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field, along with extensive experience in procurement, ideally within a global organization.
* Strong commercial and technical understanding of procurement, project management, and international contract law.
* Proven experience in functional leadership and project management.
* Long-term experience in a multinational Procurement/Supply Chain function.
* Exceptional negotiation and analytical skills.
* Fluent in both English and German.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:

- Primary point of contact for financial standards, process documentation, and training materials to ensure proper execution of day-to-day operations

- Technical/university degree in economics with a focus on finance and accounting

- Strong analytical skills
- Very good knowledge of English and of German

- Strong communication skills with appreciation for cultural diversity

jobs.occupation: Warehouse workers for Black Friday
jobs.description:
Do you envision yourself as part of the daily operations in a large warehouse, and do you thrive working independently and in a structured and high paced manner? Then you might be the one we're looking for. On behalf of DSV, Randstad is seeking warehouse workers for the upcoming Black Friday high season, where the primary tasks consist of picking, packing and scanning various products. 

As a warehouse worker at DSV, you will have a great deal of responsibility for your own tasks and for ensuring that your work is of good quality. You are able to work independently and are encouraged to take initiative, as you become a part of a fast-paced working environment. It is also important that you bring a positive energy to the team and that you want to work in close cooperation with your colleagues.

Working tasks includes:

• Handling labels

• Driving various stablers, runners, stackers etc.

• Picking and packing

• Utilizing a scanner

• Receiving goods

• Driving and replenishment of pallets, orders, packages etc.

The job can be physically requiring at times as the picking is manual, and the tempo is high.

We expect that you:

• Have experience with similar positions in previous jobs - especially driving stablers

• Are highly motivated to contribute

• Respect the operations and procedures

• You can communicate in English

• You can work independently and in a structured manner

• You are detail-oriented

• It is an advantage if you have experience using handheld scanners and picking by autostore 

Important information about the position:

• This recruitment is specifically for our Black Friday peak season. You must be available for overtime, particularly on  Sundays. During the busiest period (one week before Black Friday, Black Friday week, and one week after Black Friday), candidates are expected to be available to work on Saturdays as well as Sundays. 

• Due to the busy Black Friday period, you must not have any planned holidays or vacation during the contract period. Any time off must be approved prior to starting. Vacation requests submitted after hire will not be approved. 

• Temporary position running from week 45 (startup November 2nd–4th) until just before Christmas. 

• Your onboarding meeting will take place on your first day of work. For morning shifts, onboarding is at 08:00. For evening shifts, onboarding will take place at 14:00. Onboarding is mandatory.

• Salary: 156.50 DKK/hour for Reach Truck Operators and 143.40 DKK/hour for all other profiles. 

• Safety shoes are required.

Open positions, shifts and starts dates:

• Morning shift (06:00 - 14:00): Looking for 6 candidates (2 AutoStore pick/pack, 1 experienced reach truck operator, 1 gift wrapping, 2 manual pack/sort). Start date: 3–4 candidates on Monday 02/11 or Tuesday 03/11.

If you want to know more about the position please contact consultant Liv Nielsen on email liv.nielsen@randstad.dk. All inquiries will be handled confidentially.

About Randstad

Randstad is the world’s largest talent company and a partner of choice to clients. As a Partner for Talent, we are committed to providing equitable opportunities to people from all backgrounds and helping them remain relevant in the rapidly changing world of work.

We have a deep understanding of the labour market and help our clients to create the high-quality, diverse and agile workforces they need to succeed. We support people to realise their true potential throughout their entire working life. This is what we do and what motivates us every day.

jobs.occupation: Are you studying for an IT degree and looking for a student job where you'll gain hands-on experience with modern workplace technology, cloud services, cybersecurity, and IT operations? Then join us!
jobs.employer_name: International Council for The Exploration Of The Sea
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a service-minded IT student to join our team as a Student Assistant in Copenhagen.

About ICES

The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) is an intergovernmental organization which advances marine science and promotes sustainable use of the seas. Our Secretariat is located in central Copenhagen and consists of approximately 85 staff representing more than 30 nationalities.

We are a small, collaborative workplace with an international outlook and a strong focus on learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help support the day-to-day IT needs of colleagues across an international workplace. Working alongside four other members of the IT team, you'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technologies while helping ensure that staff can work securely and effectively both in the office and remotely.

Responsibilities
You will help with:

• 
IT support and troubleshooting

• 
Device setup and user administration

• 
Microsoft 365 services and workplace technology

• 
Meeting room and conferencing equipment

• 
IT improvements, documentation, and security activities

• 
Support cybersecurity and compliance activities, including CIS controls, using cloud and Microsoft 365 security solutions.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a student who has completed at least 3 years of education within IT, computer science, business informatics, technical engineering, or a related field, and who is currently pursuing further studies.

You do not need to know everything already. We are more interested in your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn.

For this role, we expect you to have:

• 
A strong interest in IT support and workplace technology

• 
Good understanding of Windows and Microsoft 365

• 
Confidence troubleshooting common technical issues

• 
Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

• 
A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

• 
The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, cloud technologies, device management, cybersecurity, or scripting is an advantage, but not required.

Why join ICES?

At ICES, you'll do more than provide IT support. You'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technology, work closely with experienced colleagues, and help support an international community of staff and scientists. We offer flexible working hours to fit around your studies, along with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop your skills.

Terms of Appointment

This is a paid student role, and the working hours are 15 hours per week. This position will be established with an initial duration of 6 months, with a starting date as soon as possible (preferably January 2027).

Apply Now!

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to kickstart your IT career with us! Submit your application (CV and letter of motivation) by clicking the following link: Student Assistant (IT Support and Cybersecurity) Vacancy - ICES

Deadline for application submission is midnight 28 October 2026.

Questions about the role can be directed to IT Team Lead and Enterprise Architect, Nasrullah Iqbal (nas@ices.dk)

For more information about ICES, please visit our website:  www.ices.dk

jobs.occupation: RE-ADVERTISEMENT - Senior Team Leader for Research Support at the SDU eScience Center for National Research Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Team Leader to lead the Research Support team at the SDU eScience Center. The team plays a central role in helping researchers, research groups, and institutions across Denmark leverage advanced computing, cloud, AI, and data services to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

As Senior Team Leader, you will combine scientific insight, technical understanding, and leadership skills to guide a highly skilled team of research support specialists. Working closely with researchers across all disciplines, you will help shape how next-generation digital infrastructure is adopted and utilized within Danish research.

The position offers a unique opportunity to influence both the strategic development of national research services and the day-to-day support provided to tens of thousands of researchers using the center's infrastructure and platforms.

We are looking for a collaborative and forward-looking team leader who is passionate about enabling excellent research through advanced digital technologies. The ideal candidate combines scientific and technical credibility with strong leadership skills and enjoys working at the intersection of research, technology, and service development.

Key responsibilities

• 
Lead and develop the Research Support team, including strategic planning, prioritization, and staff development as part of the management group for the eScience center.

• 
Ensure high-quality support and consultancy services for researchers and customers from the public and private sector using the center's computing, cloud, AI, and data platforms.

• 
Build strong relationships with researchers, departments, external customers, and research infrastructures across SDU and nationally.

• 
Identify emerging research and customers’ needs and contribute to the development of new services, tools, and support initiatives.

• 
Collaborate with the center's technical teams to ensure that infrastructure and services align with user requirements and scientific developments.

Required qualifications

• 
Relevant university degree at Master's level or higher in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, data science, computational science, or a related discipline.

• 
Demonstrated leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, projects, or complex research initiatives.

• 
Strong understanding of computational research, scientific computing, data-intensive research, AI, or digital research infrastructure.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in both Danish and English.

• 
The ability to engage effectively with researchers, technical specialists, customers from the private and public sector.

• 
Proven ability to translate scientific and customers’ needs into practical solutions and service developments.

Desired qualifications

• 
At least 3 years of experience from a university, research organization, national research infrastructure, or technology-oriented organization, including experience leading projects, teams, or research support activities. 

• 
Familiarity with high-performance computing, cloud computing, AI platforms, research data management, or research software engineering.

• 
Experience developing research support services, training activities, or scientific user communities.

• 
Knowledge of the Danish or European research infrastructure landscape.

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense.

About the SDU eScience Center

The SDU eScience Center is a national center for advanced digital research infrastructure at the University of Southern Denmark. The center develops, operates, and continuously advances large-scale computing, cloud, data, and AI services that support research across all scientific disciplines.

As Denmark's leading provider of research cyberinfrastructure, the center plays a central role in the national ecosystem for research computing and digital services. Through close collaborations with Danish universities, public institutions, and international partners, the center helps researchers access the computational resources and digital platforms needed to address some of society's most complex scientific and technological challenges.

The center is the primary developer and operator of UCloud, Denmark's national research cloud, which provides researchers with seamless access to advanced computing resources, AI and machine learning environments, data-intensive workflows, and scientific applications. Today, the platform serves tens of thousands of users across the Danish research community and forms a key component of the national e-infrastructure landscape.

At the SDU eScience Center, we combine the mindset of a research environment with the professionalism of a modern technology organization. Our teams work at the intersection of cloud computing, high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, data management, software engineering, and digital platform development. We actively contribute to open-source technologies and collaborate closely with researchers to transform emerging technologies into robust services with national impact.

At our center, you will be joining a highly collaborative community where brilliant minds—from IT professionals and data specialists to world-class researchers—converge to drive research innovation. We don’t just maintain servers; we build the foundational digital platforms that empower researchers, students and innovators to solve global challenges. 

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the job is as soon as possible, and it will be agreed with the successful candidate. The appointment is for a full-time permanent position.

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:

Prof. Director Claudio Pica

SDU eScience center

Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science

University of Southern Denmark

email: pica@cp3.sdu.dk

Application deadline 28 October 2026.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Radiography
jobs.description:
A position as associate professor (10% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Radiology (Odense), the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology, Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), in collaboration with University College Lillebælt (UCL) and Odense Universitetshospital (OUH), invites applications for a position as Associate Professor in Radiography, with 10% research time at the Department of Radiology, OUH. The position is offered for a five-year period with the possibility of extension. The starting date is subject to agreement.

About the research unit

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology conducts high-quality research across all radiological specialties and contributes significantly to the education and development of highly qualified staff for both clinical and academic work.

The unit values researchers with diverse professional backgrounds and has approximately 20 affiliated members, including a professor, associate professors, PhD students, adjunct professors and others.

The unit has a well-established research environment and organises a number of regular activities and meetings throughout the year, including research retreats combining academic and social activities.

Research and Teaching Responsibilities
The position involves research, academic development, research training, teaching, including examinations, supervision and assessment activities.

Qualifications and Expectations
The Associate Professor must hold a primary position at UCL.

The successful applicant must have documented research and teaching experience within radiography and a particular interest in ultrasound.

Furthermore, strong collaborative skills are required in order to further develop research in radiography, both across disciplines and at national and international level. Having international research collaborators is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

Joint Research Strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and OUH

The joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and OUH sets the direction for our shared research activities in the coming years.

Based on the vision, “We conduct research together to create the patient care of the future,” particular emphasis is placed on:

• 
Research across disciplines, with people at the centre

• 
Strong research environments as a driving force for development

• 
The research pathway from idea to impact

Further information about the joint research strategy is available on the SDU website.

Applicants Must Document

• 
A PhD degree or equivalent postgraduate research qualifications

• 
Relevant research experience documented through publications in international peer-reviewed journals

• 
Relevant clinical experience

• 
Relevant experience in educational administration

• 
A successful track record in obtaining research funding

Applicants must meet the qualifications required at Associate Professor level in accordance with the applicable Danish Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Reporting

The Associate Professor will report to Head of Research Bo Mussmann on matters relating to the associate professorship.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Research Bo Mussmann, Department of Clinical Research/OUH: Email: bo.mussmann@rsyd.dk, Telephone: +45 20 59 88 56

Application deadline

01.11.2026 at 23:59 CET

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Associate Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Kløvervænget 10, 2nd floor, 5000 Odense C, Denmark.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation. 

Your application must include the following as PDF files:

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total).

• 
a motivation letter 

• 
a detailed CV 

• 
degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma)

• 
a complete and numbered list of publications 

• 
6 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

• 
It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file

• 
a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

• 
a research plan

• 
a detailed description of research experience 

• 
an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
